quarterly_data.quarter: Organo earnings release: Consolidated Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY Ending March 31, 2027 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Three months ended June 30, 2026: orders received rose 85.0% year on year and the order backlog rose 34.6%; net sales rose 10.7% while operating profit fell 4.9%. The company says demand for advanced semiconductors such as advanced logic and HBM remained at a very high level on generative AI and data-center investment.
quarterly_data.figure: Orders received JPY 110,235 million (+85.0%); order backlog JPY 165,132 million (+34.6%); net sales JPY 42,183 million (+10.7%); operating profit JPY 6,612 million (-4.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo earnings release: Consolidated Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY Ending March 31, 2027 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Water Treatment Engineering: electronics orders rose substantially on large-scale semiconductor-related projects; the company secured multiple large-scale projects in Taiwan and also large-scale projects in the U.S., Japan and China. Electronics sales rose as Taiwan sales stayed high and large U.S. projects progressed; operating profit fell on the absence of high-margin plant projects recognized a year earlier and higher personnel and IT expenses.
quarterly_data.figure: Orders received JPY 102,474 million (+93.0%); net sales JPY 34,923 million (+8.8%); operating profit JPY 5,702 million (-6.7%)
